messages.subject: [amelia] Matrix error
messages.body_plain:
What does this error mean?
"Error in matrix(unlist(value, recursive=FALSE, use.names=FALSE),  
nrow=nr, :
invalid 'ncol' value (too large or NA)"

	I keep getting it on a dataset that I haven't had problems with in  
the past....

Best,
-Nathan
